plain: A document a lab publishes with a model describing how it was tested and what safety measures it has.
eli5: A report card that comes with a new toy, saying what tests it passed.
technical: A per-model report of capabilities, evaluations, safety findings and mitigations, often the place where a lab applies its frontier safety framework to a specific release; "model card" is the older and more general term (Mitchell et al. 2019).
